origins.title: Global ocean heat content basin time series

processing.description: Read h22-w0-2000m.dat (World Ocean heat content, 0-2000 m, in 10^22 joules; last modified by NCEI on 2026-07-06, which is the vintage, since the file carries no version), 21 rows from 2005 to 2025. The time column (year + 0.5) became the year.
Published the World Ocean column as printed. Lower and upper are that value minus and plus NCEI's standard error from the next column (one standard error). The hemisphere columns are not published.

scope.baseline: Difference from NCEI's long-term climatological mean (the World Ocean Atlas series); the files and product pages do not name the climatology's period
scope.basis: Yearly means. Heat content anomaly integrated over the layer, calculated by NCEI from in situ subsurface temperature profiles quality controlled in the World Ocean Database (method of Levitus et al. 2012).
scope.geography: World Ocean (including the Arctic Ocean), sea surface to 2000 m depth

title: Ocean heat content, 0–2000 m, yearly (NCEI)
